nom: Heimish RX Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Sunscreen

avis.titre: Nice to Try, But Ultimately Not Worth ItNice to Try, But Ultimately Not Worth It
avis.texte: Heimish Rx is a South Korean brand that has a line of products specifically for the US market. So this sunscreen, as well as probably anything else from the brand that’s available on Amazon, is going to be different from products sold by companies that ship directly from Korea. The listing didn’t mention what actives are included (only ones that weren’t), so I had no way of knowing whether the formula was different until I received my order. However, when I see a company use the PA rating system, I generally assume that they’re using more sophisticated UV filters like Bemotrizinol, since they provide better coverage than the actives currently approved but the FDA. That’s not the case here though, since the 4 main ingredients are all readily available in the US. Interestingly, the main ingredients, along with the packaging, immediately reminded of a sunscreen sold by a national supermarket chain that’s famous for their flowered shirt-wearing employees. It has the same 4 actives (albeit in slightly different proportions), similar looking box and virtually the same container, except this is blue instead of pale yellow. But that’s where their similarities end. This sunscreen from Heimish Rx has a more sophisticated formula. It’s a moderately lightweight cream that blends in smoothly and has a dewy finish. It also has a floral scent that while mild, is lingering and not terribly pleasant, especially since this is meant to go on the face. Plus, the advertised hyaluronic acid is lit
They won't let me write what I originally had. So know just know it's not worth buying. It's not a good product.

avis.titre: works great except one thing lol
avis.texte: it works well, doesn't have a weird smell, and leaves no white cast. easy to spread. I liked it! Until it started melting into my eyes, then my eyes stung and I teared up. Lol. I still like this sunscreen a lot tbh so I just avoid my eye area and use something else there and life is better now. But buyer beware.
Super lightweight and not greasy. This is my 2nd bottle and really have found that this is the only sunscreen that doesn’t leave a white cast on my face and gives me the spf coverage I need.

I like this sunscreen very much. It has a slight scent but I think it’s from its ingredients and not an added fragrance scent. I like the scent though since it smells fresh and clean. This doesn’t give me a white cast so that’s another positive. It also glides and blends well on the skin, and very lightweight which I prefer and like. Makeup goes well on top of it too. Highly recommend!

This product is wonderful. Even better than I thought it be. I watch the dermatologist who makes this product on Instagram. She is informative, reliable and relatable. I am in my early sixties and the sunscreen I put on in the morning before my makeup everyday. It is super hydrating very protective and does not burn my eyes or interfere with my foundation. I believe my makeup actually looks better when applied over this sunscreen. I love it.

avis.titre: Good quality at a good price
avis.texte: This has some thickness to make it a good sunscreen but it is not heavy! It is not as heavy as most American sunscreens. It is a Korean drug-store brand but I think equally as good as any luxury brand including dermatology-office recommended high priced brands

I normally use a competitor’s SPF 50 sunscreen and it works well but leaves me with a bluish-white cast. My skin tone is a yellow-medium brown so I look quite strange until it fully absorbs. Heimish Rx with hyaluronic acid not only keeps my skin protected with an SPF 50 rating but it goes on clear and smoothly. The lightweight formula doesn’t have a greasy finish but still locks in moisture. It’s the perfect size to always have on hand.

This hydrating sunscreen feels really good on my skin. I do not feel like I am wearing sunscreen. The sunscreen absorbs quickly and there is no white cast. Besides being SPF50+, this sunscreen also contains hyaluronic acid. I love keeping this sunscreen in my purse in case I am out in the sun too long. I highly recommend this product.

This is a very pleasant chemical sunscreen. Transparent once rubbed into skin, lightweight, very little scent, soaks in fast. Hyaluronic acid is in this, although it’s at the bottom of the ingredient list (see my photo). Also included are panthenol, vitamin E, agave tequilana leaf extract and glycerin.

I’m a stickler for sunscreen, so I tried using this one for daily wear. The sunscreen was a light cream that blended well into my skin without leaving a white cast. There is a slight scent but it didn't smell back and went away pretty fast. After using this for a week straight, I didn't have any issues with my skin getting irritated and I didn't feel like it made my skin feel super oily either ( my skin is really dry though). What I didn't like is that this sunscreen pills if I try to apply anything else on top of it. I also felt like this clogged my skin a bit because I started to develop small bumps on my face. Overall not my favorite and definitely not worth the value in my opinion.
